Attached: 1 image

Hi all,

Save the date: The **[6th International Sleep Replay Workshop](https://isrw.bio.uci.edu)** will be held in **Glasgow, UK, on Monday the 26th of July 2027**, just ahead of the [International Conference on Memory](https://icom-memory.org)!

As always, the workshop will consist of symposia, talks, and discussion groups focused on the interface between sleep and memory. We will share registration info and additional details with the [ISRW mailing list](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfLJxB_OJaKvwYMnhTxWgL2CqlI-k7TFmbhJg-ARXjX3xlsmw/viewform) later in 2026.
 
The workshop will start early on the 26th, so we recommend arriving in Glasgow the day before.

Thinking of coming to ICOM, ISRW or both? Let me know in comments!

Looking forward to seeing you there 😊

*Organizing Committee for ISRW-VI
James Antony (California Polytechnic State University)
Eleonore Duvelle (University of Glasgow)
Gordon Feld (Central Institute of Mental Health, Mannheim)
Eva Kimel (University of York)
Penny Lewis (Cardiff University)
Eitan Schechtman (University of California Irvine)
Jing Zhang (Harvard University)*
